guide.intro: UNO R3 is an ATmega328P development board. It has 14 digital I/O, 6 PWM-capable outputs and 6 analog inputs.
steps: Start with USB power for this example; do not treat VIN, 5V and 3.3V as interchangeable terminals.
For an external LED example: D9 → 330 Ω resistor → LED anode; LED cathode → GND.
D9 is an example PWM output. A suitable sketch or predefined controller behavior is needed to drive it.
Use the official UNO R3 pinout to locate the physical headers and confirm your board revision.
guide.check: This sheet describes UNO R3. UNO R4, clones and other board families can differ.

parts.name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor
parts.description: حساس مسافة بالموجات فوق الصوتية — HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor. مكوّن لاستشعار الظروف المحيطة وربطه بوحدة التحكم.

documents.title: HC-SR04 module datasheet
documents.note: مرجع وحدة HC-SR04 من ELECFREAKS؛ تحقق من نسخة وحدتك عند مقارنة المواصفات.

guide.intro: An ultrasonic distance module: a trigger pulse starts a measurement, and the echo pulse carries the return time.
steps: Supply the ELECFREAKS HC-SR04 module with 5 V and connect GND to the controller ground.
Example with UNO R3: connect TRIG to D9 and ECHO to D10. These GPIO choices are an example, not fixed module requirements.
The module requires a trigger pulse of at least 10 μs. Distance in cm is approximately echo time in μs ÷ 58.
Use suitable level shifting on ECHO before a 3.3 V-only controller input. Wiring alone does not generate measurements; controller logic is required.
guide.check: The cited HC-SR04 variant specifies 2–400 cm. Board variants and real operating conditions can differ.
